Matrix Reprogrammed turns scattered public records, institutional relationships, money routes, policy systems, source changes and investigative leads into evidence-graded maps and useful conclusions that ordinary readers can understand, verify and act on.

## Score definition

A 0–100 visual index of how strongly documented signals, implementation activity and system integration are pressing in the direction named by a timer. It is not the probability that a dramatic event will happen.

These scores are pressure indexes, not event probabilities.
